notes.title: SeabedTimes issue 427
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27812989/7895dff6707ec90e8c24bbe0dedfdac83d88f204.png[/img]

[h1][b]We are very pleased to announce the end of architecture contest for the best station![/b][/h1]
We would like to thank all the contestants for their contribution! We have chosen a few stations for the reconstruction. Visualizations are available on pages 3 to 15.

[h1][b]Some of the underwater cities are experiencing leakage problems![/b][/h1]
We have received information about some tightness issues on some stations. Please, inform your station Administrator about every inconvenience.

[h1][b]New badges for the bathyscaphe pilots![/b][/h1]
The Constructors have recently presented a lot of new medals for their subordinates. Our correspondence learned, that medals will also be given for making mistakes. Take a look at some of them on the next page!

[h1][b]More people are inside the Domes than on the surface![/b][/h1]
Central Statistical Office made a statement regarding the number of residents over and under water. More on the subject on the pages 7 and 8.

tags.feature: New badges for the bathyscaphe pilots!

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 is up and ready!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27812989/b1e78282e92f1c23a104154a859dbb6015b857e5.png[/img]

[h1]Presenting - The Lectern[/h1]
But why should you be excited as much as we are?
[list]
[*]Now you are able to easily distinguish notes.
[*]Learn where notes should be on the staff.
[*]No vertical lines - no pressure in playing. Find you own rythm and do your best!
[/list]
[i]Our dev team is giving its best to enhance the game and we hope that you will enjoy the changes! If you want to take part in making Seabed Prelude better, please visit our Community Hub and share your thoughts![/i]

[h1]Sincerely[/h1]
Seabed Prelude Dev Team

notes.title: SeabedTimes issue 300
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27812989/7895dff6707ec90e8c24bbe0dedfdac83d88f204.png[/img]

[h1][b]First large city has been flooded! Does the same awaits metropolises of the world?[/b][/h1]
“We are getting informations from around the globe, that many coastal cities are being flooded by sudden tides. More and more people are migrating to cities placed on uplands. Especially those who have not yet received the assignment in the underwater domes. Pictures on page 7.”

[h1][b]We got information, that in addition to domes, they are also building intermediate stations for the Constructors![/b][/h1]
“Our source says that Constructors have reserved the possibility of private access to some stations only for their partnership. What’s on these stations? Are they their labs? Maybe this are the places where new station improvements are tested? Maybe they are working to stop the flood? Interview on page 14.”

[h1][b]Further improvements in the underwater transport![/b][/h1]
“Constructors along with designers are working on improving the submarine transport! Piloting should be getting better! More on the next page!”

[h1][b]We have information that some of the stations have been infected by bugs! We highly recommend being careful when visiting! Apparently, some are extremely annoying![/b][/h1]

[i];)[/i]

notes.title: Seabed Times, issue 217.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27812989/7895dff6707ec90e8c24bbe0dedfdac83d88f204.png[/img]

[h1][b]Another city flooded! High-Altitude cities overcrowded![/b][/h1]
“More families were relocated due to massive floods. Dozens of factories have been flooded, we are losing more and more data, writings and arts! Country leaders are trying to provide help for the society and to save as much as possible. More on page 2.”

[h1][b]Creation of the first underwater domes has begun. Our last hope?[/b][/h1]
“The United Nations are on the final stretch of testing underwater domes. It is expected that transfer of neediest families will begin at the end of the month. Is this a chance for humanity for a new life? More on page 23.”

[h1][b]Interview with the founder and architect of the domes on page 11![/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Constructors are working on improving the size of bathyscaphes used to move between the underwater cities.[/b][/h1]
“More and more Captains are complaining about the size of bathyscaphes interiors. Constructors are working on it! More in the next issue.”

tags.feature: Constructors are working on improving the size of bathyscaphes used to move between the underwater cities.
